Apply VOI LUT Window/Level Transformation to DICOM Pixels

Source: R/plot.R
dicom_window.Rd

Applies linear window/level (Window Center and Window Width) transformation to a DICOM pixel matrix or array, normalizing output values to [0, 1]. Supports standard clinical CT window presets ("brain", "lung", "bone", "abdomen", "mediastinum", "liver", "stroke", "subdural", "angio"), embedded DICOM WindowCenter/WindowWidth tags ("auto"), or custom numeric center and width.

Usage

dicom_window(x, center = NULL, width = NULL, preset = "auto", invert = NULL)

Arguments

x

A "dicom_pixels" array/matrix or a file path to a DICOM file.

center

Numeric window center (level). Overrides preset if both center and width are provided.

width

Numeric window width (must be > 0).

preset

Character preset name ("auto", "brain", "stroke", "subdural", "lung", "mediastinum", "abdomen", "liver", "bone", "angio") or numeric vector c(center, width). Default is "auto".

invert

Optional logical to invert grayscale intensities. By default, automatically inverts if PhotometricInterpretation == "MONOCHROME1".

Value

A numeric matrix/array of the same dimensions as x with values scaled to [0, 1].

Examples

dcm_file <- system.file("extdata", "example.dcm", package = "dicomtk")
px <- read_dicom_pixels(dcm_file)
win_auto <- dicom_window(px, preset = "auto")
range(win_auto)
#> [1] 0 1
